svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Yasuo — folders, databases, APIs, terminals and notes, filed as tabs in one window

g.text: One studio. One workspace. Any number of folders.
Half a dozen apps, half a dozen window layouts — collapsed into one.

text.tspan: — every one of them a tab, in the window already open.
